programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: In this episode, host Kleber travels to Foshan in southern China’s Guangdong Province, to explore the culture of Wing Chun kung fu. There he’ll meet two Wing Chun masters: Guo Weizhan, his first instructor in China, and Xian Zhiming, an expert in the unique principles of Snake-Style Wing Chun.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In 2022, a video game inspired by Pak Mei kung fu became an online sensation. Continuing his exploration of Foshan, host Kleber meets with a true master of Pak Mei to learn more of the history of martial arts, as well as its connections to food, family and community.

programme.title: My Village is a National Treasure Ep.1
programme.desc: Dingcun village in Shanxi has a deep cultural legacy borne from a long historical tradition. Yet despite its rich resources, the village remained stagnant for years, described by local scholars as “begging for food while holding a golden bowl.” Now, Dingcun is charting a new course, developing its rural tourism by embracing its unique cultural assets.
